dimensions.description: A harmful antisemitic trope that falsely accuses Jews of ritually murdering Christian children and using their blood, often in the context of Christian iconography or imagery. This meme uses the visual of a young girl with blood and an apple (a common symbol in blood libel accusations) to imply that Israelis are uniquely capable of such a horrific act, which is a direct reference to this antisemitic stereotype.
